repo_notes.content: Apache Superset is a BI and data exploration platform. The Python/Flask backend lives in superset/ (REST APIs under */api.py, business logic in superset/commands/, data access in superset/daos/, SQLAlchemy models in superset/models/, DB dialect adapters in superset/db_engine_specs/). The React/TypeScript SPA lives in superset-frontend/ (app code in src/, shared libraries in packages/, visualization plugins in plugins/). Other components: superset-websocket/ (Node WebSocket server for async query events), superset-core/ and superset-extensions-cli/ (extension APIs and tooling), superset-embedded-sdk/ (embedding SDK), helm/ (Kubernetes chart), docs/ (Docusaurus site). Emphasize how the frontend calls the backend REST APIs, how the command/DAO layering works, and how security (RBAC, row-level security, guest tokens) is enforced. Prefer concrete file paths and class/function names over generic descriptions.

Deprioritize generated or vendored content: superset/migrations/versions/ (only summarize the migration workflow), superset/translations/, superset/static/, requirements/*.txt (generated by uv pip compile from pyproject.toml and requirements/*.in), docs versioned_docs folders, and snapshot/test fixture files. Do not document every individual database engine spec or chart plugin; describe the extension pattern and highlight a few representative examples.

pages.title: Overview
pages.purpose: High-level introduction to Superset: what it does, the main components (backend, frontend, websocket, extensions, embedded SDK), how they fit together, and a map of the top-level directories.

pages.title: Architecture
pages.purpose: End-to-end architecture: request flow from the React SPA through Flask REST APIs, commands, DAOs and SQLAlchemy models to the metadata DB and analytical databases, plus Celery workers, Redis caching, and the websocket server.

pages.title: Development Setup and Tooling
pages.purpose: How to run Superset locally (docker-compose, Makefile, superset-frontend npm scripts), Python/Node versions, pre-commit hooks, linting, and how Python requirements are pinned and regenerated.

pages.title: Configuration and Feature Flags
pages.purpose: Document superset/config.py, superset_config overrides, key settings, and the feature flag system on both backend and frontend.

pages.title: Backend
pages.purpose: Overview of the Python backend in superset/: app initialization (superset/app.py, superset/initialization/), extensions, and the layering conventions between API, command, DAO and model.

pages.title: REST API Layer
pages.purpose: How REST endpoints are built with Flask-AppBuilder ModelRestApi (*/api.py, schemas.py), OpenAPI spec generation, permissions decorators, and error handling.

pages.title: Commands and DAOs
pages.purpose: The command pattern in superset/commands/ (validation, transactions, exceptions) and the DAO layer in superset/daos/, with examples from charts, dashboards and datasets.

pages.title: Data Model
pages.purpose: Core SQLAlchemy models (Database, SqlaTable/datasets, Slice/charts, Dashboard, Query, SavedQuery, tags, reports) and their relationships, plus how Alembic migrations in superset/migrations are created and applied.

pages.title: Query Execution and Caching
pages.purpose: How chart data requests are processed: QueryContext/QueryObject, the chart data API, SQL generation for datasets, post-processing, result sets, and caching (superset/common/, superset/connectors/sqla/, cachekeys).

pages.title: Database Engine Specs
pages.purpose: The BaseEngineSpec abstraction in superset/db_engine_specs/, what dialect-specific hooks exist (time grains, error mapping, metadata, OAuth), how new databases are added, with a few representative engines.

pages.title: SQL Parsing and Jinja Templating
pages.purpose: SQL parsing/validation utilities (superset/sql/), Jinja templating context (superset/jinja_context.py), and SQL validators.

pages.title: Async Tasks and Celery
pages.purpose: Celery setup and background tasks in superset/tasks/: async queries, cache warmup, thumbnails, and scheduled jobs.

pages.title: Alerts and Reports
pages.purpose: The reports subsystem in superset/reports/ and superset/commands/report/: scheduling, execution state machine, screenshots, and notification channels (email, Slack).

pages.title: Import and Export
pages.purpose: YAML/ZIP import-export of databases, datasets, charts and dashboards (superset/commands/*/importers and exporters, superset/importexport/), including versioning and overwrite semantics.

pages.title: MCP Service
pages.purpose: The Model Context Protocol service in superset/mcp_service/: exposed tools, auth, and how it maps onto Superset APIs and permissions.

pages.title: Security
pages.purpose: Security model: SecurityManager (superset/security/), RBAC roles and permissions, datasource access checks, authentication options.

pages.title: Row Level Security and Guest Tokens
pages.purpose: Row-level security filters (superset/row_level_security/) and guest token issuance/validation for embedded dashboards, including how RLS is applied to generated SQL.

pages.title: Frontend
pages.purpose: Overview of superset-frontend/: build system (webpack), app entry points, routing (src/views, src/pages), Redux state, theming, and the monorepo packages.

pages.title: Frontend Core Packages
pages.purpose: Shared packages in superset-frontend/packages/ (superset-ui-core, superset-ui-chart-controls, superset-core, switchboard): chart registry, ChartPlugin/ChartMetadata, buildQuery/transformProps, connection utilities and translations.

pages.title: Explore
pages.purpose: The chart-building UI in src/explore/: control panels, form data, chart rendering flow, saving charts, and interaction with the chart data API.

pages.title: Dashboards
pages.purpose: Dashboard UI in src/dashboard/: layout grid and components, native filters and cross-filters (src/filters, src/dataMask), dashboard state, and permalinks.

pages.title: SQL Lab
pages.purpose: SQL Lab end to end: frontend in src/SqlLab/ (editor, tabs, results, query history) and backend execution in superset/sqllab/ and superset/sql_lab.py, including async execution, CTAS/CVAS and result backends.

pages.title: Visualization Plugins
pages.purpose: How chart plugins in superset-frontend/plugins/ are structured and registered, with the ECharts plugin as the primary example and a brief survey of other plugin families (tables, pivot, deck.gl maps).

pages.title: Frontend Testing
pages.purpose: Frontend test setup: Jest and React Testing Library conventions, spec helpers, and Playwright/Cypress end-to-end tests.

pages.title: Realtime WebSocket Server
pages.purpose: superset-websocket/: Node server that relays async query events from Redis streams to browsers, JWT auth, configuration, and the message envelope format.

pages.title: Extensions Framework
pages.purpose: The extension system: superset-core APIs, superset/extensions/, superset-extensions-cli tooling, .supx bundle format, and how frontend/backend extension contributions are loaded.

pages.title: Embedded SDK
pages.purpose: superset-embedded-sdk/: embedding dashboards in host apps, guest token flow, and the switchboard messaging between host and iframe.

pages.title: Deployment
pages.purpose: Deploying Superset: Dockerfile and docker-compose variants, the Helm chart in helm/superset, and production configuration concerns (metadata DB, Redis, Celery workers, scaling).

pages.title: Backend Testing
pages.purpose: Python test organization: tests/unit_tests vs tests/integration_tests, fixtures, how to run pytest, and CI workflows in .github/workflows.
